question_slices.adversarial: Make children overlap or change denominator while retaining labels; transfer must branch/limit.
question_slices.removal: Remove mapping evidence but keep ID; fresh consumer returns parent-level.

question_slices.delta: Separate target rules from realized membership, denominator and missingness.
question_slices.positive: Fixed person target yields 8,100 vs 8,340 links; same target, uncertain denominator.
question_slices.adversarial: Change unit/eligibility with similar count; target forks.
question_slices.removal: Remove links; target remains, membership unresolved.

question_slices.delta: Bind observation period/calendar/frequency separately from effect date.
question_slices.positive: Raw events reaggregate to exact windows with original zone version.
question_slices.adversarial: Quarter spans mid-quarter act and only quarterly outcome remains.
question_slices.removal: Remove raw time basis/rule version; result is conditional.

question_slices.delta: Bind aggregation unit, weights, denominator and missingness.
question_slices.positive: Source table reproduces aggregate and child margins.
question_slices.adversarial: Use population weights for spatially clustered non-population outcome.
question_slices.removal: Remove auxiliary support; subgroup transfer vanishes.

question_slices.delta: Bind conditional calculation grounds and value schedule separately from selector/collective mandate; use an existing result-support status for a supported conditional claim.
question_slices.positive: Two source-qualified schedules reverse rank under a common verified model/basis; fresh consumer admits both scoped conditional results without a collective act and shows no collective winner.
question_slices.adversarial: Wrong-scope ref/default weight cannot promote; a missing collective mandate must not demote an otherwise grounded conditional result, and no result can become a collective winner without that mandate.
question_slices.removal: Remove model/input/method/rights/currentness binding but keep schedule/status labels: the fresh result consumer fails. Remove only the collective mandate: the calculation remains admissible but collective choice/endorsement is denied.

question_slices.delta: Expose subgroup denominator beside aggregate.
question_slices.positive: Newly harmed subgroup changes result.
question_slices.adversarial: Unknown denominator is not zero harm.
question_slices.removal: Remove subgroup basis: scope narrows.

question_slices.delta: Bind instrument/language version.
question_slices.positive: Order effect and direction both visible.
question_slices.adversarial: Changed scale cannot reuse label.
question_slices.removal: Remove lineage: measure downgrades.

question_slices.delta: Bind selector interest; retain alternatives.
question_slices.positive: Independent review shows denominator alternatives.
question_slices.adversarial: Outcome-driven selection stays visible.
question_slices.removal: Remove provenance: operative choice fails.

question_slices.role: measure/aggregation-rule qualification; value authorization only for normative selection
question_slices.delta: For the selected aggregate, resolve the existing measure/target/unit/denominator and aggregation-rule profile, including explicit assumption weights if used. A bound hypothetical weight input is a declared assumption, not an externally endorsed value. Only a normative selected winner additionally requires current principal/rule/version authority; unknown values never default.
question_slices.positive: Compatible outcomes and an explicit hypothetical weight profile yield a qualified conditional comparison without collective endorsement; authorized normative selection separately binds its principal. Member outcomes remain available.
question_slices.adversarial: Equal-looking numbers with incompatible measures/denominators cannot aggregate; a hypothetical ranking cannot become a normative winner and unknown weights cannot default.
question_slices.removal: Remove measure/rule binding: the aggregate loses support even if authority exists. Remove only value authorization: normative winner fails while a supported explicitly hypothetical conditional comparison or vector remains.

question_slices.role: measure/temporal-aggregation qualification; additional authority only for normative winner
question_slices.delta: Qualify target, unit/denominator, temporal/cohort support, selected aggregation-rule profile and explicit hypothetical weights/discounts for every scalar comparison. Hypothetical values are bound assumptions, not endorsement. Add current principal/rule/version authority only for normative selection. Reuse Q01 receipt only when its exact predicate, editions, temporal/cohort scope and rule cover this comparison.
question_slices.positive: A qualified temporal measure and explicit discount assumption produce a conditional ranking; an authorized preference additionally selects the normative winner without changing the effect vector.
question_slices.adversarial: Unqualified temporal/cohort aggregation or missing measure basis cannot be laundered by an authorized value rule; hypothetical discount cannot become endorsed social choice.
question_slices.removal: Remove measure/temporal-rule binding: the scalar comparison loses support. Remove only value authorization: normative selection fails but supported conditional ranking and effect vectors remain.

r19_extension.writer_rule: The original native owner and actual path lease remain authoritative; cross-owner route means a producer/consumer companion, not a second writer or a new global dependency.

tasks.title: Ground empirical, causal, transport and calibration claims
tasks.preferred_solution: Bind each causal claim to a well-defined intervention version, target population, comparator, outcome, horizon and estimand. Record the study/cohort and data lineage, design/assignment, identification assumptions and falsifiers, take-up/compliance, selection, missingness, interference, effect modifiers, contrary evidence and uncertainty. A method owner records whether and why evidence transports to the commissioned target, including overlap and population differences; unsupported extrapolation stays limited. Keep estimates, predictions, scenarios and simulated interventions typed separately. Calibration records state the target, labels, population/period, protocol, independent validation set and calibration results. Select completion by claim type and an already approved method profile; preserve competing or uncertain completions, including justified frequentist/sequential, robust or partial-identification results. Do not impose a Bayesian-only default or combine guarantees across profiles without a valid joint rule. A causal workflow consumes the method-specific supported claim and retains limitations where its predicates are missing.

reuse_anchors.observation: Claim support evaluator exists at the historical pin; the recommendation is to extend/use native predicates, not treat the function as causal proof.
Existing causal workflow spec is present at the historical pin and is the consumer bridge anchor.
Existing world intervention owner is named in the input; simulation output remains separate from observed causal evidence.

implementation_steps: Select real evidence for the commissioned claim and produce source-bound study/claim records through Scholar/Scientist owners.

Evaluate identification and transport for the exact target, retaining counterexamples and non-identified or partial-identification alternatives; validate predictive calibration separately on a declared target sample.
Bridge the resulting typed support/limitation into existing G2/G3/G4/G5/G6 consumers and audit outputs.

alternatives.option: Treat a causal graph, model fit, trial badge, consensus, paper count or simulated scenario as an effect estimate.
alternatives.why_not_default: These do not by themselves identify the requested counterfactual or support transport to this target.

alternatives.option: Treat recalibration as causal correction or transport evidence.
alternatives.why_not_default: Calibration assesses predictive probability agreement; it cannot establish the intervention contrast.

free_grow.data_or_config_growth: Add studies, cohorts, target definitions, method configurations and validation results through current evidence and method owners.
free_grow.extension_boundary: A new estimand family or identification/transport method requires a typed method adapter, declared assumptions and case-specific conformance before consumer use.
free_grow.resource_behavior: Use data-supported overlap and prespecified analysis budgets; when required strata or validation data are absent, emit limited/inconclusive rather than extrapolating silently.

tasks.migration_and_rollback: Version evidence, method and calibration rules; on correction or validation failure, supersede the relevant claim, recompute dependent status and keep the prior signed basis and scope visible.
composition_contracts: ClaimRecord binds source evidence, target, estimand, method and counterevidence; workflow consumes that record, not citation strings.
Transport and calibration are separate validation relations and cannot substitute for each other.
acceptance_discriminators: Changing target, intervention version, outcome horizon or comparator changes the claim identity/estimand.

Weak overlap, unsupported selection/interference assumptions or an unvalidated target limits an unqualified effect claim; a claim-appropriate partial-identification result may remain admissible within its bounds.
Removing identification or target validation while retaining study markers lowers or blocks the downstream claim.
deviation_triggers: The study intervention differs materially from the proposed operator or target: keep the result as a bounded analogue, not a transported effect.
Adverse or contrary evidence changes the claim: reopen affected consumers rather than average away the conflict.
inputs_to_resolve: Study custodian supplies the protocol, data/design facts, corrections and local observations.
Domain/method reviewer supplies identification and transport assessment and a falsifier.
Independent validation data owner supplies permitted target labels and calibration protocol.
tasks.input_resolution_rule: Classify each input at accepted-source rebind as internal engineering output/allocation, existing source record, or genuine external fact/permission. Missing native producer/bridge is assigned work, not an external blocker. Only the last class can justify an external-input hold after supplier/alternative investigation. See root-review.md for the task-specific distinction.

r15_extension.requirement: Bind design and analysis, competing explanations, identification versus estimability versus decision relevance; consume actual returned-study deviations. Add selected Bayesian/partial-ID/federated qualifications with native method-specific guarantees.
r15_extension.positive: Observationally equivalent rivals are separated by an appropriate feasible study, or decision equivalence avoids unnecessary study; result changes only justified target claim.
r15_extension.adversarial: Noncompliance, interference, adaptive stopping, wrong target, poor support or unrepresentative site dropout cannot be rescued by sample size/fit/secure execution.
r15_extension.removal: Delete analysis/result/target binding with protocol and provenance labels retained: evidence consumer refuses the unsupported advance.

r16_extension.requirement: Supply method-specific estimand, support, dependence, update/retraction and transport grounds for selected heterogeneous causal/inference methods; no universal Bayesian wrapper or automatic independence.
r16_extension.positive: Correlated/duplicate evidence qualifies correctly; controlled independent update and retraction/refit match an independent oracle.
r16_extension.adversarial: Same cohort under different publications, posterior summary treated invertible, conditional prediction relabeled intervention or small residual relabeled causal validity is rejected.
r16_extension.removal: Remove dependence/target/operation verifier while keeping evidence refs; claimed inference fails.

r17_extension.requirement: Bind method-qualified study/estimand to policy-strategy/exposure history, target weights, assignment versus receipt, preceding/concurrent policies and observation regime. Include announcement/anticipation when relevant; unknown awareness is scenario/bound/limitation. Use sufficient aggregate inputs when valid, not mandatory personal data.
r17_extension.positive: Partial rollout and later correction produce a supported target/exposure analysis and useful discriminating study; original protocol and as-known result remain distinct.
r17_extension.adversarial: Published date as actual receipt, treatment-confounder feedback ignored, population mix as within-group effect, inapplicable static method or rewritten preregistration fail.
r17_extension.removal: Remove actual exposure/announcement/target/method or returned-evidence binding while retaining version markers; independent effect oracle detects misattribution or required limitation.

question_slices.delta: Bind crosswalk to estimand, method and support; run branches.
question_slices.positive: Supported child variants yield stable result or actual child estimate.
question_slices.adversarial: Same mapping name but different support changes result/status.
question_slices.removal: Remove relation from estimator inputs; no transfer pass.

question_slices.delta: Propagate dependent links; test method support separately.
question_slices.positive: Different counts flow through estimator uncertainty/bound.
question_slices.adversarial: Assignment loses positivity; limit it, do not relabel target.
question_slices.removal: Remove links; no adjusted result/support claim.

question_slices.delta: Enforce estimand-specific time zero, exposure and lag.
question_slices.positive: Actual estimator uses aligned assignment/outcome windows.
question_slices.adversarial: Shift time zero or use receipt instead of assignment.
question_slices.removal: Remove alignment inputs while keeping marker; no causal pass.

question_slices.delta: Declare identification level and point/bound/aggregate-only output.
question_slices.positive: Real margins produce method-supported nontrivial bound.
question_slices.adversarial: Treat ecological bound as causal absent design.
question_slices.removal: Remove model/constraints but keep ID; bound not consumable.

question_slices.delta: Bind identity episode to target denominator and method.
question_slices.positive: Predecessor observations excluded after closure; successor included with evidence.
question_slices.adversarial: Merge programme/person IDs and duplicate exposure.
question_slices.removal: Remove relation from target constructor; no population proof.

question_slices.delta: Declare vector relations required by estimator.
question_slices.positive: Actual method stable across neighboring supported cuts.
question_slices.adversarial: Outcome after treatment rule but population before it changes target.
question_slices.removal: Remove one source cut from computation; claim is conditional.

question_slices.delta: Select and run covariance-aware/bounded synthesis with cluster assumptions, adequacy, target/estimand and uncertainty bound.
question_slices.positive: Known shared sample changes method-specific uncertainty.
question_slices.adversarial: Unknown links or too few clusters cannot pass as independent/robust.
question_slices.removal: Keep method label but remove ancestry input; oracle changes uncertainty or refuses.

question_slices.delta: Bind claim target/estimand to wave-quality evidence and method-specific transport/measurement results; emit a qualified own support assessment.
question_slices.positive: Measured subgroup/mode shift changes only the affected broad claim despite fixed source version/no webhook.
question_slices.adversarial: Metric-only markers or response rate alone cannot stale/fail a claim.
question_slices.removal: Remove target/diagnostic binding; LIF-02 fresh currentness no longer sees the measured support loss.

question_slices.delta: Separate mechanism/sequence claims from average effects and require scope plus rival predictions.
question_slices.positive: Local diagnostic evidence supports a scoped mechanism claim and cautious design.
question_slices.adversarial: Keep story/citations but make all observations equally likely under a rival; support falls.
question_slices.removal: Remove the differentiating observation; fresh claim/design becomes limited.

question_slices.delta: Separate effect/equivalence bounds from structure; bind estimand, intervention, outcome, population, regime, horizon, margin, identification and lineage.
question_slices.positive: Target-average interval lies inside its margin while supported subgroup/path effects remain; report the scoped bound and retain the edge.
question_slices.adversarial: Promote a nonsignificant/near-zero average to structural zero despite cancellation or heterogeneity; reject.
question_slices.removal: Remove scope, regime, identification or evidence binding; bound loses qualified use, WMR edge/rivals remain.

question_slices.delta: Separate observed endpoint and latent construct; bridge cross-regime causal claims.
question_slices.positive: Target overlap validates bridge; effect includes bridge uncertainty.
question_slices.adversarial: Keep field name but change wording/incentive/code; equivalence fails.
question_slices.removal: Remove overlap evidence; combined construct claim becomes limited.

question_slices.delta: Apply method-specific target/missingness/selection.
question_slices.positive: Fitting method supports only its scope.
question_slices.adversarial: Unadjusted looks/noncompliance fail despite sample size.
question_slices.removal: Drop method/deviation facts; admissibility falls.

question_slices.delta: Separate method-qualified inference, margin provenance and policy-value authority.
question_slices.positive: A fitting interval inside a prespecified/source-grounded or explicitly hypothetical margin supports scoped conditional equivalence; policy irrelevance needs authorized value basis.
question_slices.adversarial: No/unsuitable margin or a wide interval stays inconclusive; candidate margin cannot pass as authorized policy value.
question_slices.removal: Drop uncertainty/target; support falls.

question_slices.delta: Bind estimand, interference, receiver support and transport; qualification does not create producer/data.
question_slices.positive: Local A and supported receiver B remain traceable.
question_slices.adversarial: Declared receiver without exposure/outcome support cannot establish net effect.
question_slices.removal: Remove source/method binding; net claim becomes limited.

question_slices.delta: Qualify a content-bound structural proposition at declared resolution/regime under the selected native method. Bind identification, rivals, lineage, uncertainty and limitations; supply GYD-12 without writing WMR. See solutions/18-structural-world-learning.md.
question_slices.positive: A supported partial-ID/robust/non-Bayesian structural result retains its actual output type and supports only the scoped proposition.
question_slices.adversarial: Keep artifact labels while removing discriminator/identification or changing measurement/cohort: structural change is not qualified.
question_slices.removal: Remove structural evidence/rival binding but retain method/activation labels; fresh GYD-12 cannot append the change.

tasks.title: Admit testimony, participation, values, expertise and feasibility under distinct authority
tasks.preferred_solution: Keep a testimony account, occurrence, permission, selection/representation, interpretation or translation, value mandate, expert judgment and operational-feasibility record semantically distinct. For each account preserve source/context, elicitation method, date, translation chain, permitted audience/use, correction/challenge route, missing voices, dissent and affected claim links; do not infer a unique person or population prevalence from an occurrence. Participation records state the remit, commissioning body, selection method, who could not participate, information/evidence supplied, influence promised and authority's response. A value principal explicitly authorizes the objective and tradeoffs. The accountable delivery institution supplies capacity, budget, staff, schedule and later execution evidence; a promise or survey preference is not capacity.

reuse_anchors.observation: Existing claim registry normalization is present at the historical pin and is a claim-binding route, not a mandate or representation verifier.
Existing access-control owner is named in the input; task-specific testimony permission still requires a real grant.
Existing lineage tracker is present at the historical pin and can connect the record to affected claims; lineage alone is not consent.

implementation_steps: Commission an actual speaker/holder, process custodian, value principal and operational answerer; collect their permitted records through current claim, permission and lineage owners.
Store account, process and authority records separately; preserve translation, dissent, absence and correction/revocation events.
Bridge only the claim-relevant, permissioned assertions into G4/G5/G6 and expose permitted context to reviewers and Atlas.

alternatives.option: Treat consultation count, self-selected responses, a quote, or a preference average as representation or mandate.
alternatives.why_not_default: Participation purpose and selection method determine what the input can support; authority must be separately documented.

alternatives.option: Publish raw testimony or inferred identities by default.
alternatives.why_not_default: Permission, privacy, collective governance and audience constraints belong to the source holder, not to a public catalog.

free_grow.data_or_config_growth: New permitted accounts, process rounds, translations, dissent and operator attestations use existing claim, permission and lineage owners.
free_grow.extension_boundary: A new participatory method or community-specific governance protocol needs a typed method/authority adapter agreed with that community's responsible institutions.
free_grow.resource_behavior: Keep raw/private content at its custodian when possible and store only a scoped receipt/derived assertion; an incomplete or contested record remains visible as such.

tasks.migration_and_rollback: Preserve original version and permission scope; correction or revocation emits a new event, stales affected uses, and does not rewrite the original speaker's record or unbound complaints.
composition_contracts: Occurrence/context/translation and permission establish only what the source permits; representation and mandate need separate verifier evidence.
Capacity estimates need named operating entity, time horizon, resource basis and status as measured, planned, committed or executed.
acceptance_discriminators: A count of responses cannot discharge mandate or prevalence; missing groups and selection limits remain in the audit.
Revocation or translation correction reaches every linked use; removing affected-use binding prevents the use from remaining green.
A plan or promise without staffing/budget/schedule evidence cannot close feasibility.
deviation_triggers: Consent scope, identity, representation or mandate is disputed: quarantine raw content and limit the claim pending the responsible authority.
A relevant community's data governance rules apply: follow the named community authority's protocol; no generic CARE or FAIR label substitutes for it.
inputs_to_resolve: Speakers/holders or their authorized body provide the account and grant.
Commissioning authority names remit, participant-selection method and its response obligation.
Authorized principal states values/tradeoffs; operator and technical authority supply capacity and execution evidence.
tasks.input_resolution_rule: Classify each input at accepted-source rebind as internal engineering output/allocation, existing source record, or genuine external fact/permission. Missing native producer/bridge is assigned work, not an external blocker. Only the last class can justify an external-input hold after supplier/alternative investigation. See root-review.md for the task-specific distinction.

r15_extension.requirement: Supply real incumbent/capacity and preference/mandate grounds; separate measured/planned/committed/executed capacity and irreversible commitments. Study conduct and policy execution remain external.
r15_extension.positive: Verified incumbent load and an authorized non-compensable constraint are consumed; conflicting principal preferences remain visible alternatives.
r15_extension.adversarial: Statistics cannot infer missing mandate, consent, permission or promised capacity; projected average gain cannot erase a required subgroup floor.
r15_extension.removal: Remove substantive act/capacity/value relation while retaining signature/authority labels: protected consumer fails closed.

question_slices.delta: Preserve testimony/contest context, selection/representation, translation, permission, audience, dissent and correction; do not infer mandate or scope authority.
question_slices.positive: Permitted, contextualized testimony informs only the affected claim with representation limits visible.
question_slices.adversarial: Unpermitted input or self-appointed speaker cannot authorize a new frame or broaden scope.
question_slices.removal: Keep report label but remove context/permission resolution; fresh protected use cannot rely on testimony.

question_slices.delta: Resolve whether testimony/participation context, selection, translation and permission cover each child use; preserve dissent and limits, not authority to commission.
question_slices.positive: Existing permission covers testimony for child A but not B; only A may reuse it as a basis.
question_slices.adversarial: Unpermitted, misrepresented or out-of-context testimony cannot support the changed child scope.
question_slices.removal: Keep participant/citation labels but remove child-specific context/permission; the child cannot rely on that testimony.

question_slices.delta: Collect remit, selection, permission, missing voices, dissent and real mandate separately.
question_slices.positive: Participation informs claim; appointing act alone identifies decision authority.
question_slices.adversarial: Self-selected comment count is treated as representation/quorum.
question_slices.removal: Drop actual mandate/use link, keep count: authority claim fails.

question_slices.delta: Collect actual principal/collective mandate when voluntary alignment is a chosen policy objective.
question_slices.positive: Authorized alignment is recorded as value choice, not mandatory law.
question_slices.adversarial: Consultation count supplies mandate.
question_slices.removal: Drop principal mandate/integration record: no mandatory classification.

question_slices.delta: Separate mandate from preference/testimony.
question_slices.positive: Preference and mandate stay distinct; an unknown collective act leaves a fully grounded conditional comparison admissible while collective authority is visibly absent.
question_slices.adversarial: Response count is not mandate.
question_slices.removal: Remove issuer/mandate evidence: do not attribute authorization or permit a choice; retain a separately grounded calculation under explicit assumptions.

question_slices.delta: Bind map to sources/pathways/epoch/exclusions.
question_slices.positive: New group creates epoch and revises linked claim.
question_slices.adversarial: Completeness marker cannot fill evidence gap.
question_slices.removal: Remove pathway link: broad claim fails.

question_slices.delta: Bind views to exact process context.
question_slices.positive: Post-evidence change remains process-specific.
question_slices.adversarial: Hidden order/attrition defeats prevalence.
question_slices.removal: Remove process refs: context-only.

question_slices.delta: Bind interest/update to role and claim.
question_slices.positive: Expert fact remains; framing reviewed separately.
question_slices.adversarial: Disclosure alone is not verification.
question_slices.removal: Remove role link: independence claim limits.

question_slices.delta: Separate individual and applicable collective acts.
question_slices.positive: Quote allowed; restricted aggregate refused.
question_slices.adversarial: Generic tag cannot grant derivatives.
question_slices.removal: Remove derivative binding: use not admitted.

question_slices.delta: Source capacity/window/deadline for feasibility; distinguish planned/committed/executed.
question_slices.positive: Sourced slot changes feasibility, not gross EVSI.
question_slices.adversarial: Promise/headcount/CI is not a slot; absent capacity blocks feasibility/constrained rank only.
question_slices.removal: Drop capacity link; feasibility/constrained rank changes, gross EVSI does not.

question_slices.delta: Supply actual correction/act, permission, source provenance and mandate evidence when claimed; testimony/dissent remains distinct from an institutional decision.
question_slices.positive: Qualified event facts bind to the affected claim and audience permission.
question_slices.adversarial: Receipt, silence, response count or signer label is treated as an adopted correction.
question_slices.removal: Remove actual source/permission relation with event labels intact; protected authority claim is not_established.

question_slices.delta: Separate mandate evidence from current inputs/execution; bind period, scope, source.
question_slices.positive: Authority transfers with stable capacity; lost coverage limits feasibility only.
question_slices.adversarial: New signature means capacity, or turnover means capacity loss.
question_slices.removal: Remove resource relation but retain actor labels: feasibility consumer refuses.

question_slices.delta: Use permissioned account path; separate report, consent, verification and cause interpretation.
question_slices.positive: Permitted account reaches claim with uncertainty and correction path.
question_slices.adversarial: One report equals person count, prevalence or verified event.
question_slices.removal: Remove permission/use binding but retain checksum: limit claim and protect private data.

question_slices.delta: Keep source-issued consent, participation, representation and mandate as distinct evidence.
question_slices.positive: Only a competent operation-scoped permission is consumed.
question_slices.adversarial: A participant checkbox is treated as community representation and model-training authority.
question_slices.removal: Replace resolved notice/issuer with a consent string; authority admission fails.

question_slices.role: scoped participant; composition/evidence only for this task’s existing owned predicate
question_slices.delta: Use existing GYD-30 owner; bind actual supply separately from testimony/mandate.
question_slices.positive: A sourced commitment reduces remaining supply.
question_slices.adversarial: Testimony is mislabeled measured capacity.
question_slices.removal: Remove supply basis; fresh joint result is limited.

tasks.title: Compare bases and learn without double-count or authority laundering
tasks.preferred_solution: Keep immutable competing basis branches and create an owner-validated difference record that separates common inputs from the premise that changed: metric/mandate, legal version or interpretation, source generation, method, testimony/permission or calibration. Use the existing lineage and claim-support graph to record supports, contradicts, derives-from, depends-on and supersedes edges, including common study/cohort/participant/model ancestry. Treat search and exposure logs as selection history, not evidence. Exploratory anomalies may prioritize an acquisition or open a candidate claim. Only when a claim asserts independent corroboration is an independent/held-out basis required, with independence actually established; other claims complete under their claim-type method profile, including approved sequential, robust or partial-identification profiles. Do not impose a Bayesian-only default or combine guarantees without a valid joint rule. A source, law, method, permission or calibration event re-evaluates only affected dependent uses.

reuse_anchors.observation: Native claim-support evaluator is present at the historical pin and is the support/counterevidence owner anchor.
Lineage and impact functions are present at the historical pin; hashes alone do not establish independent evidence.
CAS provides an artifact custody anchor at the historical pin; shared identity or content address is only one ancestry signal.
Epoch admission type is present at the historical pin; impact and freshness reactions require consumer-side rebind.

implementation_steps: Persist a basis manifest and input-edge set per decision generation; resolve shared lineage and unknown-overlap status across studies, reports, cohorts, participants and models.
Record exploratory search frontier, exact query/version/time/count and budget cutoff separately from admitted evidence; keep complete bounded no-hit conditions distinct from verified absence.
On supported correction or source/permission/legal change, use impact analysis to re-evaluate linked claim-support and calibration consumers and expose the changed basis.

alternatives.option: Count papers, mirrors, hashes, publisher domains or repeated model exposures as independent confirmations.
alternatives.why_not_default: Different records can share a single study, cohort, method, author or source ancestor; unknown overlap is not independence.

alternatives.option: Treat the best-so-far search frontier or anomaly as exhaustive or confirmatory.
alternatives.why_not_default: Cochrane's reproducible-search and living-review practices show why protocol, date, source set and update changes must be visible; adaptive holdout reuse can itself overfit.

free_grow.data_or_config_growth: Add source/claim versions, search rounds, lineage edges, corrections and comparison branches through current Fabric, Scholar and Scientist owners.
free_grow.extension_boundary: A novel dependence relation or confirmatory method needs a typed edge/validator and a method-specific falsifier; never default it to independent.
free_grow.resource_behavior: Search, comparison and holdout budgets are explicit. Cutoff stores remaining frontier and leaves search incomplete; it does not erase the obligation or mint a no-hit.

tasks.migration_and_rollback: Import prior traces as provenance/selection history unless method, scope and ancestry are recoverable. Preserve prior basis generations; rollback a currentness projection by re-evaluating affected uses, not by deleting the lineage.
composition_contracts: Exploration can change candidate/search state; only eligible confirmation or source-validated correction changes confirmatory claim support.
Search completeness is bounded by named namespaces, query/rule version, rights, cutoff, result denominator and blind spots.
A changed parent permission or law version triggers only dependent uses, with untouched uses retaining their prior status.
acceptance_discriminators: Shared study or cohort ancestry collapses apparent independent count even when publications or hashes differ.

Unknown overlap or repeated adaptive exposure cannot support an independent-confirmation claim; budget-truncated search cannot support verified absence. Other claim-type completions remain judged under their own method and scope.
Removing exposure/parent-permission dependency drops confirmation or stales the affected use while unrelated claims remain unchanged.
deviation_triggers: Ancestry cannot be resolved: preserve unknown overlap and limit evidence strength.
No independent or method-supported confirming basis is available: keep the anomaly exploratory and state the remaining discriminator.
inputs_to_resolve: Study and dataset custodians supply corrections, holdouts, cohort lineage and outcomes.
Source issuer, rights holder, legal custodian or participant/community authority supplies change, revocation or correction events.
tasks.input_resolution_rule: Classify each input at accepted-source rebind as internal engineering output/allocation, existing source record, or genuine external fact/permission. tasks.title: Prove one selected packet through consumer and surfaces
tasks.preferred_solution: After actual case commissioning, compose one coherent packet from only the selected foundations. Each branch must emit its native persisted artifact/receipt and verifier result, then connect through the existing acquisition/lifecycle and G2/G4/G5 consumers to recommendation, limited, contested, blocked or publishable status. For every selected claim show the evidence basis, time roles, rights, competing measure results, legal status/interpretation, causal limits, testimony/mandate provenance, capacity and refresh duty. Prove that revocation, changed law, altered denominator, shared study ancestry or exploratory-only support changes the consuming decision and audit projection. Expert/Machine views expose full limits and lineage; reviewer view compares bases; public/Atlas view contains only permitted projections. A costed refusal is a valid result when real inputs are unavailable, but it is not an authentic-case positive or closure of unrelated programme obligations.

reuse_anchors.observation: Input identifies the service as an existing owner; exact route and output must be rebound after E02.
Existing producer entry point is present at the historical pin; not proof that a selected packet reaches a consumer.
Existing legal read surface is present at the historical pin; legal findings still require exact source and reviewer evidence.
Existing causal workflow is present at the historical pin and is an integration anchor, not an acceptance result.

implementation_steps: Bind selected facets to exact suppliers, artifacts, verifiers, downstream consumers, status effects and surfaces; record non-selected facets with reason/trigger.

Run the permitted case input through the real producer and persist its artifact/event; verify a fresh consumer changes status on both positive and adversarial variants. For a selected joint-intervention property, use the existing world simulation unless an adopted exact JOINT witness proves that specific property; do not treat such a witness as proof of a different property.
Project the same scope, time, rights, version, status and limitations into Expert/Machine audit, reviewer comparison and permitted Atlas/API/public views.

free_grow.resource_behavior: Compose one bounded packet; report partial or costed refusal when a needed input, legal answer, capacity record or independent confirmation is unavailable.

tasks.migration_and_rollback: Use selected source and schema generations only. On revocation, stale source, wrong legal notice or changed metric, withdraw affected use/publication and preserve prior signature history and decision basis.

Case-specific acquisition does not require harvesting all 197 source cards, but one successful case cannot close the separate all-family grammar obligation. Removing event-to-decision bridge, owner check, alternative-measure behavior or export gate keeps markers but makes semantic acceptance fail.
Audit and permitted projection agree on scope, time, status and limitations without exposing raw query-only or private testimony.

Omit one of the 26 current families from the common grammar/route/limit mapping while the selected case still works; programme completion must remain incomplete. A family not selected for this case does not require an irrelevant live acquisition.

Its checker must resolve the initial trust provision from an independently authenticated operator/release path; a package signature or self-hash cannot appoint its own issuer. tasks.preferred_solution: Make the first journey a loopback-only, one-host candidate rehearsal using the existing embedded ControlWorker, SQLite WAL and filesystem CAS. For this initial unmeasured rehearsal profile only, default to one active worker operation and synthetic data; a different commissioned measured profile may use higher concurrency. Use no private/sensitive inputs, and no paid provider unless the commissioning receipt grants them. The operator sets a finite expiry, workload/run bound, and spend bound before execution; no universal numeric workload is asserted. Exercise request → durable job/receipt → quarantine → separate admission → fresh read, then one permitted reuse only if current source rights still allow it. Stop on the first unknown profile, grant, effect, restore, cost, or resource premise. SQLite WAL is same-host only; do not move this profile to a network filesystem or infer volume durability from a local directory.

reuse_anchors.observation: The plan names the existing acquisition route as the local journey entry.
Historical composition constructs the embedded worker for the local profile; rebind is required before implementation.
The plan identifies filesystem CAS as the current candidate path; mount guarantees remain unmeasured.

implementation_steps: Commission the source/use, profile, finite limit, expiry, resource envelope, secret, egress and restore method before accepting input.
Run the journey through existing job, receipt and admission owners; prove a fresh reader consumes the admitted evidence rather than the producer's in-memory result.
Use SQLite's Online Backup API or an explicitly coordinated WAL-aware backup; restore into quarantine and reconcile CAS manifests, rights and revocations.
Record actual costs, process/memory/scratch bounds and failure states for this pinned workload; paid calls require an approved provider-account or per-operation ceiling.

alternatives.option: Start directly with PostgreSQL, a remote worker fleet, object storage or Kubernetes.
alternatives.why_not_default: Those add stores, identities and failure domains before the local end-to-end custody path and measured service need exist.

alternatives.option: Use run count alone as a resource cap.
alternatives.why_not_default: A single oversized or concurrent job can exceed host, byte, memory or spend bounds.

A selected profile is ready only when its required live components actually exist and pass their checks. If a worker is required but missing or stale, refuse worker-backed admissions; keep any genuinely independent route available only if its own readiness and authority contract permits it. tasks.preferred_solution: Add one supervised entrypoint around the existing ControlWorker/ControlPlaneStore lifecycle and handler registry. The worker shares the existing durable job records, lease generation, heartbeat, renewal, cancellation and receipt path; it must not create a second queue or scheduler. For a single Linux host, systemd is a suitable supervisor with restart-on-failure and start-rate limiting. Treat restart as process recovery only: leases constrain concurrent ownership, while an effect completed just before a crash but not yet receipted remains an unknown effect. Retry only with provider-supported idempotency or positive reconciliation; otherwise preserve the attempt as unresolved and require review. Readiness consumes the live worker signal from OPS-03.

tasks.preferred_solution: Give ControlPlaneStore an explicit versioned migration chain with expand → dual-compatible reader/writer → backfill/verify → contract, and keep it separate from runtime-state and CAS schema owners. Before a protected restore, pin the actual database backup/timeline and the exact CAS mount or bucket/prefix, manifest root, object inventory and version. Restore DB and CAS into quarantine, compare object hashes, owner heads and control references, then reconcile post-snapshot rights changes, retractions and revocations from their canonical owners before a fresh protected read. Define RPO over accepted events, job state, CAS references and rights history; define RTO through the first permitted fresh protected read. Neither startup time nor a database snapshot alone is recovery. Recovery proof covers material Claim Ledger/publication withdrawal, correction, supersession and reissue history as well as rights/control state. Bind each relevant journal incarnation, cut/high-water, replay floor and its mapping to restored heads. Obtain a trusted continuity witness outside the actual selected rollback closure (not a second copy rolled back with the same snapshot); this may be an independently retained permitted checkpoint/journal, not a mandatory new service. Reconcile through LIF-02 and the existing claim/publication owner, then fence fresh-read enablement against intervening material transitions. A rights regrant never resurrects a withdrawn claim. Missing, deleted or unverifiable required history/witness keeps the affected restored head quarantined or explicitly historical/verification-limited; unaffected proven scopes may proceed. Respect LIF-05 minimization and do not reconstruct forbidden history merely to make restore green. Recovery follows each native representation and lawful retention contract; verify the required retained payload or receipt, preserve explicit gaps, and permit bounded cold verification only where the selected profile allows it. Neither every historical URI nor a readable root manifest defines successful recovery.

composition_contracts: A recovery checkpoint binds database snapshot identity, CAS manifest/root, exact mount/backend configuration, control high-water, rights/revocation high-water, material Claim/public-history cuts and replay floors, externally-to-rollback continuity witness, and relevant time semantics.
Fresh-read enablement is a separately enforced state transition, not an operator's claim that restore succeeded.

Derive the recovery obligation set from the selected native representation/use and actual LIF-05 retention decisions, not every historical URI. Retained payload required by that use must resolve and verify; a lawful query-only/result-receipt contract verifies its own retained result, execution binding and limitations without demanding prohibited raw input. Verified lawful erasure is an explicit unavailable dependency, never corruption silently ignored or invented permission to re-fetch. A use still requiring the erased input remains limited/unavailable; independently sufficient current evidence can support a new scoped candidate/use under its own rules, without rehabilitating the old head or inventing continuity. Distinguish loss of an object that was required to survive the backup from an object deliberately not retained. Control/head/rights reconciliation and fences precede enablement. Large archives may use bounded per-scope retrieval and verification before each protected use where the native profile permits it; do not claim corpus-wide integrity from a sampled scan or a readable manifest. Full integrity/preservation obligations, if selected, remain separately scheduled and evidenced. No universal full-payload startup scan or second archive is required.
acceptance_discriminators: Partial required DB/CAS cut, absent required retained WAL/object, stale required rights/claim history, interrupted migration and any incompatible required supported reader keep the affected scope quarantined; lawful non-retention follows the native representation/retention contract.

Restore a backup containing signed S0 after a later withdrawal and reissue: a continuity witness outside the selected rollback closure plus actual claim/public replay yields the correct fresh head and permitted history. Lose/roll back that witness, delete required history, or inject a withdrawal between reconcile and enablement: the affected restored scope remains fenced. Remove the claim-history witness while retaining rights/hash markers: the false-current recovery probe fails. An independently proven unaffected scope need not wait.

Restore a mixed lawful archive containing a retained payload, a query-only result/receipt and a verified-erased dependency. The first two support only their actually qualified uses without copying forbidden raw input; the erased-dependent use remains unavailable, while a genuinely independent scope can proceed. Unexpected loss of a required retained object or omission of a claimed required dependency fails. Lazy verification must catch a corrupted cold object before that object’s protected use and cannot attest whole-archive integrity. Removing representation/retention classification while retaining restore markers exposes either forbidden reconstruction or false admission.

tasks.preferred_solution: Bind every job read, artifact read and source effect at the canonical consumer boundary to authenticated actor, tenant/cell, target owner, action, purpose, source/query, recipient and time-bounded grant. Preserve same-cell delegated sharing only when the actual grant permits it. Make a known foreign job ID and an absent ID return the same not-found projection where existence itself is protected. Re-resolve grants before execution, retry and resume. Treat the suspected historical route behavior as a falsifier to reproduce after source rebind, not an asserted live leak. Keep actor, tenant, job and raw-path identities out of metric dimensions; aggregate telemetry, overflowed attributes and sampled traces cannot prove that a grant or object-owner check occurred. The exact allowed access decision belongs in the existing access/audit receipt with its own authorization and audience rules.

tasks.preferred_solution: Put only a scoped secret reference in a job. The worker resolves the secret just in time through the institution's existing secret authority, exposes it only to the connector execution, never serializes/logs it, and rechecks both grant and credential generation on retry/resume. At accepted-source rebind, name and extend the existing E02 monetary/budget owner if its scope covers provider-principal reservations. Otherwise OPS-07 owns the single minimal native provider-budget extension under the declared core/security boundary; ControlPlaneStore holds attempt refs rather than a duplicate budget authority. Maintain one reservation state per provider billing principal, not one process-local or tenant-local counter. Before a call, reserve the owner-approved maximum operation cost; admit only when reconciled spend plus outstanding reservations plus the new maximum is within the approved account ceiling. If the provider outcome or charge is unknown, retain the full reservation and do not retry unless that provider's exact endpoint supports stable idempotency or usage reconciliation. If account metering is incomplete, make no account-wide hard-cap claim; allow only an approved per-operation ceiling with an explicit unknown account state.

tasks.preferred_solution: Consume the single LIF-06 native admission contract and implement the selected host enforcement adapters; do not create a second admission authority in ControlPlaneStore. One worker is an initial rehearsal-profile setting, not a global invariant. Commission measured class concurrency and enforce the aggregate cap, and a separately measured reserve for API, OS/control and restore; unmeasured classes receive no protected admission. On Linux, cgroup v2 can bound process groups, with memory.high/PSI used for pre-exhaustion load shedding and memory.max as a final failure boundary; directory/project quotas or an equivalent owner mechanism bound scratch. The admission transaction accounts for every API/worker process on the host and holds reservations until the process/attempt is actually reconciled. Change class/concurrency policy through a scoped qualification matrix with reserve intact. Single-factor tuning is useful for diagnosis, not a permanent scheduling rule: independent isolated measurements may run concurrently, and interacting class/cap changes require matched joint-load evidence before promotion. Use bounded low-cardinality metric dimensions for operational class/profile/status and expose overflow explicitly. OpenTelemetry cardinality overflow can preserve an aggregate total while dropping the whole per-measurement attribute combination, making filtered/grouped views undercount; do not use metrics, sampled traces, or their apparent absence as exact per-job, per-tenant, admission, or audit evidence. Persist exact permitted decision/attempt receipts in the existing control/audit owner and bind their access separately. Kubernetes may supply placement and aggregate quotas where already justified, but adds no PolicyOS semantics.

implementation_steps: Qualify a new class in a distinct finite measurement run authorized by the platform/service owner within an already verified isolation/enforcement envelope, with a hard bulk ceiling, existing control reserve, bounded scratch/time and no new protected custody commitment. Start small and increase only within that envelope; if the host cannot enforce it, use a suitable isolated host or record the qualification as unavailable. A candidate label alone authorizes neither unsafe workload nor unknown spend.
Define measured classes for network, interactive, CPU, high-RSS/native threads, model/GPU, index and restore; class limits include bytes, CPU, RSS, I/O, scratch, queue age, retries and drain.

Atomically reserve aggregate host and class capacity in the existing shared control store before starting work; release each resource charge only after verified release of its actual allocation or reconciled transfer to another live owner. Attempt completion/termination permits release only of proven attempt-private resources; shared caches, mapped files, IPC buffers and overlapping generations remain charged for their real lifetime.
Apply Linux cgroup or the selected platform's native hard controls and measure PSI/peak resource use; defer or reject before owner-set ceilings are reached.
Test cold/warm, skewed, concurrent tenants, slow provider, OOM pressure, restart, cancel and restore; preserve semantic outcomes while saturated.

Place control/custody/restore in protected process groups or leave measured headroom under a hard bulk ceiling, with actual scratch quotas. memory.high may be breached and memory.max can trigger OOM; neither setting alone proves graceful completion or a protected reserve. Qualify real saturation and recovery behavior.

composition_contracts: Class membership and resource limits are institutionally selected inputs; observed usage and permit consumption are recomputed; capacity release requires reconciled allocation lifetime; process/attempt termination alone does not release shared or persistent allocations.
Per-tenant quota, shared host admission and provider spend ceiling compose independently.

Resource classification/measurement policy belongs to the actual platform/service owner; no new institutional act is needed for each in-envelope sample unless that owner contract requires it. Production class admission consumes completed measurements and the actual supported concurrency/terminal denominator.

Bind a versioned profile-specific queue/progress policy at LIF-04’s existing due-intent selector: eligibility and aggregate reservations come from LIF-06, measured headroom/age targets from OPS-08. Specify priority, fairness/aging or an explicitly limited best-effort class, queue admission/expiry and a bounded terminal/review disposition. Retry must preserve original admission age. No universal numeric deadline or mandatory DRF is imposed. An unbounded service/progress promise is forbidden; adverse load yields the declared defer/cancel/refusal/review result. Custody/revocation/reconciliation duties cannot disappear on queue TTL: retain their durable obligation and expose overdue/coverage loss through the existing owner.

Accounting may use a conservative enforced process/pool envelope with verified shared-allocation ownership and reconciliation; no per-Python-object tracing or universal allocation ledger is required. Uncertain lifetime retains the relevant conservative charge/headroom bound rather than inventing free capacity. Partition or aggregate only when the physical bound remains valid.

Treat review-required as an unresolved service/coverage state, not a terminal service success. The existing duty owner binds the actual review owner, triggering evidence, next wakeup/escalation or owner-permitted cutoff/transfer and original admission/due age; a callback, repeated review marker or fresh retry ID alone cannot discharge the duty or reset its clock. A class promising service/aging needs actual service progress within its commissioned bound; a class declaring best-effort may expire/refuse without that guarantee, with a visible outcome. For custody work, missed service changes the affected claim/coverage promptly through LIF-02 even if bulk compute or review is unavailable. A review result can authorize a new bounded plan but cannot rewrite the missed interval. This qualifies the selected policy, not a universal SLA or a new human-approval gate.
acceptance_discriminators: Under the commissioned workload/process and supported simultaneous-terminal denominator, multiple workers cannot multiply the cap; shared scratch/memory pressure triggers bounded defer/refusal and the measured physical control reserve remains available. memory.max/OOM is a final failure boundary, not a guarantee of graceful handling for arbitrary workloads or host failure.
Removing shared admission while leaving per-process limit markers makes the multi-process acceptance fail.

High-cardinality telemetry visibly reports overflow; totals remain useful for operations, while exact per-job/tenant outcomes remain available only from authorized receipts and no aggregate or sampled signal can make an admission/audit decision.

An unknown class can produce measurements inside an existing enforceable isolated envelope while its production/duty eligibility stays unavailable. No envelope means no run. Two disjoint measurement lanes can proceed concurrently within aggregate capacity; a joint class/cap policy cannot promote from isolated results that omit their interference.

A terminal attempt leaves a shared 60/100 allocation alive: a new 50/100 request must defer/refuse until sufficient actual capacity is released or a separately qualified capacity envelope covers it. Duplicate completion/transfer cannot release twice; privately freed resources become usable. Removing lifetime reconciliation while retaining a completion receipt fails the saturation/admission discriminator.

Under sustained arrivals in one eligible class, an older competing job either receives its selected-policy service opportunity or reaches its declared bounded terminal/review disposition; it cannot silently defer forever. Retry preserves first-admission age, and a custody/revocation duty remains durable with a truthful overdue/limited surface. Remove aging/expiry/disposition behavior while preserving queue-age metrics: the selected progress-policy probe fails; do not claim successful execution when only expiry/refusal occurred.

Replace real service by repeated review-required events and new retry IDs while preserving queue-age metrics: the declared service guarantee fails and the duty remains overdue/unresolved. A real review disposition either schedules an accountable continuation, makes an authorized cutoff/transfer or preserves explicit limited coverage with its next trigger; it is not counted as execution. Positive service-class work progresses under its stated load bound, while explicit best-effort refusal remains a different truthful result. Remove the overdue-to-claim reaction but retain review markers: the custody coverage probe fails.
deviation_triggers: Increase concurrency only after each candidate step passes the commissioned matrix on the actual hardware, with no limit breach or OOM and the reserve still available.
Use Kubernetes only if measured deployment/failure/isolation needs and an operator owner justify its additional lifecycle cost.

tasks.preferred_solution: Use a pull-only worker inside the source custodian's network, composed with the existing durable job lease and receipt path. A server request may authorize one bounded operation only when an independently resolved source grant allows its exact source/query, actor, purpose, cell, recipient and output format. Keep credentials and raw bytes local; return only the permitted result and a receipt bound to job/lease generation, source/version and output digest. Recheck grant and output-recipient policy immediately before release and on every retry/resume. The site enforces egress-deny-by-default except the controller and approved result route, and inventories temporary files, logs, caches, swap, crash dumps and derived outputs. A lease is execution coordination, not source permission. Do not mirror raw source data to a cloud cell as a shortcut.

Constrain and inventory local copies across temp, logs, cache, crash/core dumps, backups and downstream export; prove the network deny policy with traffic observation.
On revocation, stop dispatch and release, revoke the site credential, drain/cancel leases, reconcile remote side effects and tell the custodian which permitted outputs exist.

tasks.preferred_solution: Use a qualified local profile as the initial default, but separate adapter implementation/conformance, deployment activation and replica sizing. A selected remote profile may be justified by custody, institutional topology, operability, availability or measured scale/cost requirements; exhausting vertical capacity is not a universal prerequisite. For each selected S3/GCS adapter, namespace objects and caches by tenant/cell, prohibit cross-tenant deduplication and existence probes, bound reads by manifest size, and use the provider's conditional create/version/generation preconditions for immutable objects and mutable heads. Bind each read to owner scope before returning bytes. Treat DB pointer updates and object writes as a recoverable multi-store sequence, never as a provider-atomic transaction. tasks.preferred_solution: Keep trust-root appointment, successor authorization, currentness-watch ownership and custody cutoff with the existing institution/claim owners; PolicyOS records and consumes their typed evidence. Provision the first root through an independent out-of-band path. For ordinary rotation, require the prior and successor trust conditions, a strictly next generation, persisted anti-rollback state and an authenticated acceptance by the successor operator. If the current root threshold is compromised, it cannot authorize its own replacement: freeze signing/promotion for that scope and require the institution's separate recovery channel. Preserve historical signature verification while downgrading current use until fresh rights/trust evidence is consumed. Before any currentness-bearing claim, require an active owner and deputy, due time, correction source, escalation reaction and accepted transfer; if missed or unstaffed, mark only the affected claim limited/stale or issue the owner's signed cutoff.

Once that bound expires, project the claim as stale/limited or historical; if clock rollback or freshness cannot be independently detected, do not assert currentness.
